literal: The soft shoulders of excellently jeweled women who have no restraint are the deep mire in which base people without nobility sink.
translation: The soft shoulders of beautifully jeweled women who lack moral restraint are a deep mire in which ignoble men sink.
modern: வரையறை இல்லாத, சிறந்த அணிகலன்களை அணிந்த பெண்களின் மென்மையான தோள்கள், மேன்மை இல்லாத கீழ்மக்கள் மூழ்கிக் கிடக்கும் நரகமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the allure of women who sell themselves without any moral restraint or commitment. The poet describes their soft, beautifully adorned shoulders not as a place of pleasure, but as a deep, muddy hell or mire (அளறு) where base, unprincipled men (பூரியர்கள்) sink and lose themselves. The word 'வரைவு' refers to restraint or marriage, indicating women who are not bound by marital fidelity or moral limits. The word 'அளறு' literally means mud or mire, and by extension, hell, emphasizing the inescapable ruin that awaits those who yield to such lust.
